title: NFR manifest
description: Response-time, concurrency, and data-volume targets, each traced to the load-test definition that checks it. The template's values are illustrative examples, not production promises. It defines no execution policy. Each team decides when load tests run.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion.

schemaVersion.description: Raised when a field is removed or renamed.

responseTime.description: Illustrative example: the value shows the format and is not a promise. Pass when the measured percentile is at most maxMs.

concurrency.description: Illustrative example: the value shows the format and is not a promise. Pass when the run held at least this many virtual users and no request failed.

dataVolume.description: Illustrative example: the value shows the format and is not a promise. Pass when the table holds at least this many rows.

illustrative.description: true while the value is the template's illustrative example. Set false when the project sets a real target.

verifiedBy.description: Path, relative to the template root, of the load-test definition that checks this target.
